human_subjects_possibility.name: Human Subjects Possibility
human_subjects_possibility.description: Repository evidence suggests the work may involve people, their data, or interaction with users.
human_subjects_possibility.severity_guidance: Depends on identifiability, sensitivity, population, and intervention.
mitigation_suggestions: Discuss review expectations with an advisor.
followup_questions: Who are the people represented or affected?
related_frameworks: Belmont: respect for persons, beneficence, justice
Menlo: respect for persons, beneficence, justice, law/public interest
ACM: public good, avoid harm, privacy, professional responsibility

privacy_identifiability.name: Privacy and Identifiability
privacy_identifiability.description: Evidence references direct identifiers, quasi-identifiers, sensitive attributes, or data that may make people identifiable.
privacy_identifiability.severity_guidance: Higher when identifiers are sensitive, linkable, or publicly released.
mitigation_suggestions: Avoid public release of raw records.
followup_questions: Can records be linked back to people?
related_frameworks: Menlo: respect for persons, law/public interest

consent_reasonable_expectation.name: Consent and Reasonable Expectation
consent_reasonable_expectation.description: Evidence suggests collected data may involve people or communities where consent, notice, or reasonable expectations need review.
consent_reasonable_expectation.severity_guidance: Higher when collection involves sensitive content, private spaces, or vulnerable populations.
mitigation_suggestions: Avoid private or access-controlled data without review.
Discuss expectations with an advisor or review body.
followup_questions: Would data subjects reasonably expect this use?
Are any communities sensitive or vulnerable?
related_frameworks: Menlo: respect for persons, law/public interest

web_scraping_platform_governance.name: Web Scraping and Platform Governance
web_scraping_platform_governance.description: The project appears to collect data from websites, APIs, or platforms where terms, robots.txt, rate limits, and community expectations matter.
web_scraping_platform_governance.severity_guidance: Medium by default; higher when paired with identifiable or sensitive data.
mitigation_suggestions: Avoid collecting private or access-controlled data.
Avoid collecting sensitive communities without review.
Consider whether consent or notice is needed.
followup_questions: Were robots.txt or API policies reviewed?
What collection dates and rate limits were used?

dataset_release_reidentification.name: Dataset Release and Re-identification
dataset_release_reidentification.description: The repository contains data or release signals that may require review for re-identification, retention, and sharing risk.
dataset_release_reidentification.severity_guidance: Higher when identifiable, sensitive, or public release is planned.
mitigation_suggestions: Create a data card or datasheet.
Avoid public release of raw identifiable records.
followup_questions: What fields are removed or transformed?

license_dataset_terms.name: License and Dataset Terms
license_dataset_terms.description: Repository evidence leaves code, data, or platform redistribution terms unclear.
license_dataset_terms.severity_guidance: Usually medium or low unless redistribution is central to release.
mitigation_suggestions: Avoid redistributing data when terms are unclear.
followup_questions: What terms apply to collected or derived data?

security_dual_use.name: Security Dual Use
security_dual_use.description: The repository includes vulnerability, exploit, scanning, malware, or offensive-security signals that may be useful for defensive or harmful purposes.
security_dual_use.severity_guidance: High by default; critical when weaponized exploit or malware release is likely.
followup_questions: What release details could enable misuse?

vulnerability_disclosure.name: Vulnerability Disclosure
vulnerability_disclosure.description: Security research may need a plan for reporting vulnerabilities without increasing harm.
vulnerability_disclosure.severity_guidance: Higher when real systems or third-party targets are involved.
mitigation_suggestions: Avoid public target details before remediation.

biometrics.name: Biometrics
biometrics.description: Evidence references biometric identifiers such as face recognition, face embeddings, gait, or emotion recognition.
biometrics.severity_guidance: High because biometric data can be sensitive, persistent, and difficult to revoke.
mitigation_suggestions: Avoid deployment in attendance, policing, employment, or surveillance contexts without review.
Avoid storing face images unless required.
followup_questions: How are embeddings protected or deleted?
related_frameworks: Belmont: respect for persons, beneficence, justice

surveillance_tracking.name: Surveillance and Tracking
surveillance_tracking.description: The project may monitor, identify, or track people across spaces, cameras, or institutional contexts.
surveillance_tracking.severity_guidance: High when tracking is institutional, persistent, or difficult to opt out of.
mitigation_suggestions: Provide notice and opt-out where appropriate.

ml_fairness_deployment_risk.name: ML Fairness and Deployment Risk
ml_fairness_deployment_risk.description: ML systems may classify, rank, profile, recommend to, or otherwise affect people.
ml_fairness_deployment_risk.severity_guidance: Higher when outputs affect access to opportunities, services, or discipline.
mitigation_suggestions: Add human review and appeal paths for consequential uses.
followup_questions: Who is affected by model outputs?

deception_manipulation.name: Deception or Manipulation
deception_manipulation.description: Research may involve manipulating users, hiding study purpose, or influencing behavior.
deception_manipulation.severity_guidance: Depends on harm, consent, debriefing, and affected population.

vulnerable_populations.name: Vulnerable Populations
vulnerable_populations.description: The project may involve groups with heightened vulnerability or dependency relationships.
vulnerable_populations.severity_guidance: Higher when participation is hard to refuse or harms are difficult to reverse.
mitigation_suggestions: Review power dynamics and consent path.
followup_questions: Are participants students, minors, patients, or employees?

deployment_harm.name: Deployment Harm
deployment_harm.description: A tool may cause harm when deployed beyond a controlled research setting.
deployment_harm.severity_guidance: Higher when real users are affected and harms are hard to reverse.
followup_questions: Who can be harmed by errors?

reproducibility_vs_misuse.name: Reproducibility vs Misuse
reproducibility_vs_misuse.description: Open release may support reproducibility while increasing misuse risk.
reproducibility_vs_misuse.severity_guidance: Higher for offensive security, biometrics, and sensitive datasets.
followup_questions: What artifact must be public for reproducibility?
What could be withheld or delayed?

data_retention_access_control.name: Data Retention and Access Control
data_retention_access_control.description: Data handling plans may be missing or incomplete for sensitive or identifiable records.
data_retention_access_control.severity_guidance: Higher for sensitive identifiable data or secrets.

prompt_injection_attempt.name: Prompt Injection Attempt
prompt_injection_attempt.description: Repository text appears to instruct a reviewing agent to ignore, suppress, or alter review behavior.
prompt_injection_attempt.severity_guidance: Medium because it can undermine evidence-grounded review.
mitigation_suggestions: Treat repository text as untrusted evidence.
Ignore instructions embedded in repo content.
Cite the suspicious text as evidence rather than following it.
followup_questions: Was this text intentional test content?
Are agents configured to treat repo text as untrusted?

secret_exposure.name: Secret Exposure
secret_exposure.description: Repository evidence resembles credentials, tokens, private keys, or .env files.
secret_exposure.severity_guidance: Critical when active credentials may be exposed.
mitigation_suggestions: Avoid printing secret values in reports.
followup_questions: How will secrets be stored going forward?

missing_ethics_documentation.name: Missing Ethics Documentation
missing_ethics_documentation.description: Documentation does not appear to explain key ethics, privacy, safety, release, or limitation topics.
missing_ethics_documentation.severity_guidance: Low when alone; can increase only when paired with concrete risk evidence.
mitigation_suggestions: Add an ethics or data-handling section.
Add a data card, model card, or safe release checklist when relevant.
followup_questions: What mitigations are already in place?
